name: deep-copilot
description: Deep Copilot — AI coding agent embedded in VS Code. Authored by ZhouChaunge, modded by difr.

commands.title: Deep Copilot: Open TUI in Terminal
Deep Copilot: Move to Secondary Side Bar
Deep Copilot: Switch API Base URL
Deep Copilot: Set Tavily API Key (Web Search)

deepseekAgent.serverExecutablePath.description: Path to deepseek-app-server executable. Leave empty — Deep Copilot is standalone and does not need a backend.

deepseekAgent.serverPort.description: API server port (unused in standalone mode).

deepseekAgent.apiBaseUrl.description: AI provider Base URL. When set, it overrides the selected provider's built-in endpoint; leave empty to use the built-in one.

enumDescriptions: Custom — use the Base URL configured above
deepseekAgent.provider.description: AI provider. Selecting a preset auto-fills the Base URL in the settings UI.

deepseekAgent.providersDir.description: Optional absolute path to a directory containing additional provider JSON files (same schema as the built-in ones in src/providers/). Files here override built-in providers with the same id, letting you add new vendors or replace model lists without rebuilding the extension. Reload the window after editing.

deepseekAgent.defaultModel.description: Override for the chat model id. Leave empty to use the model declared by the selected provider (deepseekAgent.provider) — the model list itself lives in src/providers/*.json, not in this setting.

deepseekAgent.subAgentModel.description: Override for the model used by spawn_agent sub-agents. Leave empty to use the provider's subAgentModel (a cheaper/faster variant, so parallel sub-agents don't exhaust the primary model's quota).

enumDescriptions: Manual — approve write_file / run_shell each time (safest, default)
Auto-Edit — auto-approve file writes, prompt for shell commands
deepseekAgent.approvalMode.description: Tool approval policy for write_file / run_shell.

deepseekAgent.fastThinking.description: Fold reasoning (Thinking) sections while a turn runs: they appear collapsed, and their text is not rendered token by token, so a long think-aloud does not slow the panel down. Click a section to expand it.

deepseekAgent.autoApproveTools.description: Tool names to always auto-approve (overrides approvalMode), e.g. ["write_file"]

deepseekAgent.denyTools.description: Tool names to always deny (overrides approvalMode), e.g. ["run_shell"]

deepseekAgent.includeMcpTools.description: Include MCP tools in every request. Disable to save prompt tokens when MCP tools are not needed for the current session.

enumDescriptions: Silent — run commands in a hidden subprocess, output is only sent back to the model (default, fastest).
Terminal — run commands visibly in a VS Code integrated terminal so the user can watch the full output live.
deepseekAgent.shellExecutionMode.description: Default run_shell execution mode. silent = hidden subprocess; terminal = VS Code integrated terminal (user-visible). Can be overridden by the tool call in_terminal parameter.

deepseekAgent.enableDebugLog.description: Log every request's chain-of-thought / tool calls / API events to .deep-copilot/logs/ and the Output panel for debugging stuck sessions.

deepseekAgent.contextRefs.terminalUseCli.description: Allow #terminal to capture terminal selection via the system clipboard (temporarily overwrites clipboard contents; non-text clipboard may be lost). Off by default.

deepseekAgent.terminal.captureHistory.description: Allow the read_terminal tool to read your integrated terminal's recent output. When enabled, the extension keeps the last 20 commands' output for each terminal in memory (max 64KB each, not persisted, cleared on VS Code close). Requires Shell Integration (bash/zsh/fish/pwsh enabled by default; cmd.exe not supported).

deepseekAgent.maxIterations.description: Max tool-call iterations per send. 0 (default) = unlimited — the agent runs until the task is done, guarded by stagnation detection. Set a positive number (e.g. 20) only to cap API cost on simple tasks.

deepseekAgent.compactBudgetTokens.description: Explicit token budget for auto-compaction. 0 (default) derives it from the active model's context window via deepseekAgent.compactBudgetShare — set a positive number to pin it.

deepseekAgent.compactBudgetShare.description: Share of the active model's context window used as the compaction budget when compactBudgetTokens is 0. Default 0.75, i.e. 750K on a 1M-token window and 150K on a 200K-token one.

deepseekAgent.compactMaxMessages.description: Hard cap on the messages in one conversation. Growing past it compacts the history down to compactKeepTail even when the token budget is not reached; that cut uses compactKeepTail / compactMaxMessages as its share of the current size.

deepseekAgent.compactKeepTail.description: Messages kept verbatim when the head of the history is summarised. A larger tail survives compaction byte-identical (good for the prefix cache), a smaller one frees more room for the summary. Values at or above compactMaxMessages are clamped.

deepseekAgent.compactHardLimitShare.description: Emergency ceiling as a share of the model's context window. When the prompt is expected to exceed it, the aggressive compaction ladder and the nuclear fallback run to avoid an HTTP 400.

deepseekAgent.autoResumeMaxPerHour.description: Background wake scheduler: maximum auto-resumes per session per hour to prevent runaway API cost from frequent watcher wake-ups. Default 12.

enumDescriptions: Auto — Tavily when a key is set, otherwise DuckDuckGo chain or Bing as final fallback
Tavily — best quality, requires API key (1000 free searches/month)
DuckDuckGo — no API key required, Lite/HTML endpoints with ranking
Bing — no API key required, uses Bing RSS
deepseekAgent.webSearchProvider.description: Web search backend. Tavily requires an API key; DuckDuckGo and Bing work out of the box without an API key. Auto uses Tavily when a key is configured and falls back to the DuckDuckGo chain otherwise.

deepseekAgent.postEditDiagnostics.description: After each successful write_file / str_replace_in_file / apply_patch, append VS Code language-server diagnostics (errors + warnings) to the tool result so the model self-verifies before reporting success.

enumDescriptions: Agent — model can autonomously call tools (file reads, edits, shell, etc.). Recommended for coding tasks.
Plan — model can only use read-only tools to explore and produce a plan. All write/shell tools are blocked. Switch to Agent mode to execute the plan.
deepseekAgent.interactionMode.description: Interaction mode. Agent: full tool access. Plan: read-only exploration + plan generation, no writes or shell commands.

deepCopilot.inlineCompletion.enable.description: Enable DeepSeek FIM-powered inline (ghost-text) completions in the editor. Off by default — turn on after configuring your API key.

deepCopilot.inlineCompletion.debounceMs.description: Idle delay (ms) after the last keystroke before requesting an inline completion. Lower = snappier but more API calls.

deepCopilot.inlineCompletion.maxTokens.description: Maximum tokens per inline completion. The FIM endpoint caps output at 4K; a lower value keeps ghost text short and cheap.

deepCopilot.inlineCompletion.model.description: Model used for FIM (fill-in-the-middle) inline completions. DeepSeek FIM is documented for deepseek-flash and deepseek-v4-pro and runs in non-thinking mode only.

deepCopilot.inlineCompletion.baseUrl.description: Optional API base URL for FIM completions. Leave empty to use the built-in DeepSeek base URL. For safety the API key is only ever sent to deepseek.com hosts, so a custom proxy here disables inline completions instead of leaking the key.

deepseekAgent.fileEncoding.markdownDescription: File encoding by glob pattern, relative to workspace root. The `*` key (reserved — not a valid filename) sets the project-wide default. Example: `{ "*": "utf8", "trunk/**": "cp1251", "*.rc": "cp866" }`. Workspace-level — put in `.vscode/settings.json`.
